featured.image: auto:Strait of Hormuz ADNOC oil tanker ships
featured.imageKeywords: Strait of Hormuz ADNOC oil tanker ships UAE Iran shipping
featured.title: Strait Of Hormuz Crisis Deepens
featured.content: Tensions around the Strait of Hormuz have intensified after the United Arab Emirates accused Iran of attacking two ADNOC vessels while they were transiting the strategic waterway. Reuters reports that no injuries were recorded and ADNOC said the situation was brought under control. The incident comes as shipping through the waterway remains heavily disrupted, keeping global energy markets on alert.
